# SAT Samarkand

> SAT Samarkand is an offline SAT preparation centre in Samarkand, Uzbekistan. It teaches Digital SAT Math and Reading and Writing in small groups and one-to-one, in English, Uzbek and Russian. Founder and head teacher: Faridun Shavkatov (SAT 1520: Math 800, Reading and Writing 720). More than 500 students have studied here.

- Address: Temur Malik 19, Samarkand, Uzbekistan
- Phone: +998 95 113 16 00
- Telegram and Instagram: @sat_samarkand
- Hours: Monday to Saturday 9:00–19:00; mock SAT on Sunday at 10:00
- Course prices are given on request by phone or Telegram and are not published online.
- SAT® is a registered trademark of College Board, which is not affiliated with SAT Samarkand.

## Centre

- [Courses](https://satsamarkand.uz/courses/): SAT Intensive, SAT MAX and individual lessons
- [Mentors](https://satsamarkand.uz/teachers/): the five mentors and their SAT scores
- [Results](https://satsamarkand.uz/results/): student scores and university admissions
- [Contact](https://satsamarkand.uz/contact/): addresses, phone, Telegram
- [Free diagnostic test](https://diagnostic.satsamarkand.uz): estimate of a student's current SAT level
